name: Cirrus Insight
description_en:
Cirrus Insight connects email, calendar and tasks with Salesforce. Its sync documentation describes configurable matching to related objects and controls for what gets captured. This is particularly relevant to sales operations that needs activities in Salesforce reporting, rather than a separate database of outreach metrics. Near-Time Sync is a specific feature, not a promise that every integration is instantaneous.

For an illustrative pilot, connect Salesforce credentials and the intended email environment, choose email/calendar/task capture rules, and verify one external meeting against the correct contact and opportunity. Smart Link matches to related records, while historical sync is a separate service to inquire about. Document who may change matching rules before broad deployment; an incorrectly attached meeting can distort account reporting even when the sync itself succeeds.
description_zh:
Cirrus Insight 把邮箱、日历与任务连接到 Salesforce。同步文档描述可配置的关联对象匹配与采集范围控制。它尤其适合需要在 Salesforce 报表中读取活动的销售运营，而不只是查看另一套触达统计。Near-Time Sync 是具体功能，不能视为所有集成都即时完成的承诺。

可按以下建议试点：连接 Salesforce 凭据与目标邮箱环境，选择邮件、日历、任务的采集规则，并核对一个外部会议是否关联到正确联系人和商机。Smart Link 用于匹配关联记录，历史同步则是需另行询问的服务。全面部署前应记录谁可修改匹配规则；即使同步成功，关联错误的会议仍会扭曲账户报表。

core_features.explanation_zh: 按配置规则采集邮件、日历与任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Match activity to related Salesforce records.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把活动匹配到关联的 Salesforce 记录。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; not an executed test or customer result.

Evaluation scope.en: Official public documentation research. Account setup, integrations and delivery were not executed.
Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

steps.en: For an illustrative pilot, connect Salesforce credentials and the intended email environment, choose email/calendar/task capture rules, and verify one external meeting against the correct contact and opportunity. Smart Link matches to related records, while historical sync is a separate service to inquire about. Document who may change matching rules before broad deployment; an incorrectly attached meeting can distort account reporting even when the sync itself succeeds.
steps.zh: 可按以下建议试点：连接 Salesforce 凭据与目标邮箱环境，选择邮件、日历、任务的采集规则，并核对一个外部会议是否关联到正确联系人和商机。Smart Link 用于匹配关联记录，历史同步则是需另行询问的服务。全面部署前应记录谁可修改匹配规则；即使同步成功，关联错误的会议仍会扭曲账户报表。

items.en: The sync page describes child organizations for separate email tenants and one-way or bidirectional options. Verify direction, exclusions and related-object behavior before rollout, then compare source activity and Salesforce state if records go missing or duplicate. This is evaluation advice; exact retry guarantees were not verified. The reviewed service is managed online; source-code licensing and self-hosting were not confirmed. It suits Salesforce-centered workflows, while a team without Salesforce should first establish whether the required product scope fits.
items.zh: 同步页描述了为不同邮箱租户建立子组织，以及单向或双向选项。上线前应验证方向、排除规则与关联对象行为；记录缺失或重复时应对照源活动与 Salesforce 状态。这是评估建议，尚未核实精确重试保证。本次资料描述托管在线服务，未确认源代码许可与自托管。它适合以 Salesforce 为中心的流程；不使用 Salesforce 的团队应先核实所需功能是否适配。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page currently presents modular per-user monthly prices, with different headcounts per feature rather than one uniform edition. Examples include $39/user/month for sequences and $12/user/month for Email Blast. Confirm the exact module names, billing term and required user counts in a quote. A free-trial entry exists, but no ongoing free plan was established. Older bundled-edition prices should not be substituted for this current modular view.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前定价页按模块展示每用户月价，允许各功能使用不同人数，而非统一购买一个版本。例如序列为每用户每月 39 美元，Email Blast 为 12 美元。报价时仍需确认准确模块名称、账期与必需人数。官网有免费试用入口，但尚未证实长期免费套餐，不能用旧版捆绑套餐价格代替当前模块报价。
